summary.text: On Kamigawa, where the mortal and spirit worlds lie side by side, the Kami War begins when Lord Konda raids the Spirit World and tears out O-Kagachi's heart, enraging the kami so that they strike at the mortal world.
Michiko Konda, the thief Toshiro Umezawa and the ogre Hidetsugu, whose attack destroys the Minamo school, are drawn into the war.
In the war's twentieth year Michiko frees the spirit Kyodai, and together they defeat O-Kagachi and Konda, with O-Kagachi's death merging the two realms.
